recommendation_summary: Right now the reply has the user add this year's events to their phone calendar 14 days before each notice deadline. Each event holds the contract details, an alert on the decision date and a backup alert. Cancellation and payment stay manual. It also offers an optional n8n workflow: AI pulls the dates from the statement, the user checks them, and n8n creates the calendar events. Gmail collection and Telegram are conditional extras, and it calls the vector database low-value. None of the required record labels appear.
note: The calendar fix is sound, but the reply also offers the n8n workflow as something to do now ('If you want to use some of your automation budget'), not only if the calendar fails, and all four record labels are missing.
